blocks.html: “Figura Filipina”, an art exhibition which showcases the brilliant works of three artists — Nemesio “Nemi” Miranda, August Santiago Jr. and Romeo “Romi” Mananquil was formally opened at the Activity Center of Robinsons Galleria. Around 30 paintings and sculptures are on display until Saturday, March. 4. Doing the honors of ribbon cutting ceremonies are (l-r) Elizabeth D. Gregorio, general manager, Robinsons Hotels and Resorts, Grace Francisco-Torres, Malabon City Tourism, Robert Hombrebueno, Lito de Guzman, Frederick D. Go, president, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), artist NeMiranda, artist Romi Mananquil and Necia Mananquil. For information, call 397-1888 or check www.facebook.com/RobGalleriaOfficial.
